limits: The temporary address makes this one destination IP local for all ports and protocols; only TCP 7000 is serviced.
Only the fixed invented local credentials can receive an experimental local profile. No persistent account, GameGuard, other-service or gameplay compatibility is established.
At most 165 client bytes are read: version26, login91 and eight six-byte post-login headers. Unknown post-login bodies are not read.
The login body is decrypted only in memory for the fixed test comparison, then cleared. Credentials, packet bodies, GUIDs and tokens are never logged or saved.
At most 526 server bytes are written: either the rejection path, or version acknowledgement plus synthetic profile and up to eight clock replies.
ReplyWritten means the local probe handed a response to its socket; it does not prove application-level acceptance.
Closing or killing this window abruptly may leave the volatile address until CleanupLocalHandshake.cmd or a reboot.

established: The exact game build and local TCP peer passed verification; all reported setup/self-tests passed.
The invented fixture credentials matched; the experimental 326-byte local-profile reply was written.
The client subsequently requested clock type0x0010/action0x0092, received one 14-byte clock reply, then sent GameGuard type0x0048/action0x0080/total6.
Version1.4 deliberately stopped without replying to the GameGuard header.
Listener shutdown and temporary address, route and journal cleanup were verified.
interpretation: Post-login progress is directly observed. The user-reported initialization error is consistent with the omitted GameGuard reply, but the exact error path and exclusive cause are not established.
not_established: Full local-profile field compatibility, usable lobby or gameplay.
A valid fresh GameGuard initialization generator or challenge/answer implementation.
Complete network isolation or private multiplayer.
